info.comment: Flat vector onboarding illustration: welcome to a civic desk. A simple standing desk with a navy nameplate, a white inbox tray, and a blue memo sheet with three gray lines. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, limited palette navy #1B3A6B, bright blue #2F6FED, cool gray #8A93A0, white, light gray #E6EBF2. No text, no letters, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, generous negative space, crisp edges.
